info.title: GenAI Input Messages
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.input.messages attribute, describing the messages sent to a GenAI model.

InputMessages.description: Represents the list of input messages sent to the model.
x-otel-deviation: Allow DecideRequest in addition to ChatMessage, since `gen_ai.decide` operations send a state and questions instead of chat messages.
Allow ExtractRequest in addition to ChatMessage, since `gen_ai.extract` operations send a state and field specs instead of chat messages.

DecideRequest.description: Represents one or more questions about the content supplied in state.
x-otel-deviation: OTel does not define this definition or any of the definitions it references.

state.description: The content all questions in this request refer to.

questions.description: Questions to ask about the content, each with a name you choose. The response uses those names to identify the answers.

Question.description: A question about the supplied content.

NoulQuestion.description: A yes/no question or statement, answered with the probability of yes or true.

type.description: Identifies a yes/no question or statement.

instructions.description: The yes/no question or statement to evaluate.

criteria.description: Criteria clarifying what counts as a yes or no answer.

NoulCriteria.description: Criteria defining what counts as a yes or no answer.

true.description: What counts as a yes answer.

false.description: What counts as a no answer.

ChoiceQuestion.description: A question that selects one option from the choices you define.

type.description: Identifies a question that selects one of the choices in criteria.

instructions.description: What the model should decide when choosing an option.

criteria.description: Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.

ScoreQuestion.description: A question that assigns a score using an ordered rubric.

type.description: Identifies a question that rates the content using the levels in criteria.

criteria.description: Ordered descriptions of the score levels. Each description's position determines its score, starting at zero.

ExtractRequest.description: Represents the request of a `gen_ai.extract` operation: the request body as the caller passed it, without the model. Keys that the caller did not set are left out. The array holds exactly one such request.
x-otel-deviation: OTel does not define this definition or any of the definitions it references.

state.description: The text that the model reads.

fields.description: The field specs, keyed by field name.

images.description: The images that the model reads, each as a string.

documents.description: The PDF documents that the model reads, each as a string.

reference_date.description: The date that anchors dates written without a year.

options.description: The options that the caller passed to the provider.

ExtractField.description: Represents the spec of one field to extract. The field type sets which keys apply.

instructions.description: The instructions that tell the model what the field contains.

nullable.description: Whether the answer can be null.

unit.description: The unit of the value, such as `USD` or `days`.

integer.description: Whether the value must be an integer.

decimals.description: The number of decimal places of the value.

knowledge.description: Whether the model can answer from knowledge that is not in the input.

source_only.description: Whether the answer must be printed in the input.

minLength.description: The minimum length of a text answer.

maxLength.description: The maximum length of a text answer.

pattern.description: The regular expression that a text answer must match.

minimum.description: The minimum value of a number answer.

maximum.description: The maximum value of a number answer.

exclusiveMinimum.description: The exclusive minimum value of a number answer.

exclusiveMaximum.description: The exclusive maximum value of a number answer.

enum.description: The permitted values of the answer.

properties.description: The property specs of an object field, keyed by property name.

items.description: The items of a list field: the name of the item type, or the spec of an object item.

max_items.description: The maximum number of items in a list answer.

min.description: The lower limit of an estimate or a forecast: a number, or an ISO date.

max.description: The upper limit of an estimate or a forecast: a number, or an ISO date.

step.description: The grid step of an estimate: a number, or `month` or `year`.

scale.description: The scale of the estimate grid.

null_threshold.description: The probability of null above which the value is null.

horizon.description: The number of steps of a forecast.

interval.description: The interval between the steps of a forecast.
